deadline.value: Students who want assistantship consideration should complete applications by January 15; rolling admission otherwise, and international applicants should apply 6 to 12 months ahead.
deadline.quote: students seeking financial support through research or teaching assistantships are encouraged to have complete applications submitted by January 15 for admission and support consideration for the fall semester

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact faculty about research topics; this is not required for admission.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are encouraged to contact individual faculty concerning specific research topics and projects.

funding.value: Funding is provided on a competitive basis to students who are admitted.
funding.quote: Funding is provided on a competitive basis to students admitted to the graduate program.

entry_route.value: The civil page's applicant requirements are written for the MS, and the PhD entry rule is not stated.

gre_general.value: The department says the GRE is not required for MS or PhD admission.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for admission to our program, whether it's for the Master of Science or Ph.D. programs.

notes: This is one Ph.D. in Engineering with three options run by this department: Civil, Applied Mechanics, and Environmental. The Environmental option is also offered through the chemical engineering department. The Applied Mechanics option is not saved as a separate mechanical record.
